text: The 'Iso' record in Cubical Agda consists of:
choices: a function and its inverse only
a function fun:A→B, its inverse inv:B→A, and two proofs rightInv and leftInv showing they are quasi-inverses
two functions in the same homotopy class
explanation: Iso A B = { fun:A→B; inv:B→A; rightInv: fun∘inv~id; leftInv: inv∘fun~id }. It is a quasi-inverse. isoToEquiv converts an Iso to an Equiv (correcting the coherence).
